hero.title: Education and Environmental Information
hero.description: Explore information about education, learning opportunities, environmental protection and community participation in our village.

intro.title: Building an Educated and Environmentally Responsible Village
intro.description: Education creates opportunities for a better future, while environmental awareness helps protect the resources we depend on. The Gram Panchayat encourages awareness, participation and collective efforts in both areas.

message.title: A Message for Every Citizen
message.description: Every child deserves the opportunity to learn, and every citizen has a role in protecting the environment. Parents, students, teachers, youth and community members can work together to build a knowledgeable, healthy and sustainable village.

education.title: Education and Learning Facilities
education.description: Access to education, guidance and learning resources helps children and young people develop their knowledge, skills and confidence.

schoolInformation.title: School Information
schoolInformation.description: Get information about educational institutions, school-related activities, learning opportunities and the importance of regular attendance and quality education.

educationFacilities.title: Educational Facilities
educationFacilities.description: Learn about available educational resources and facilities that support students, encourage learning and help create a positive educational environment.

higherEducation.title: Higher Education
higherEducation.description: Students can seek guidance about further studies, courses, admission procedures, career opportunities and available scholarship information after completing school education.

environment.title: Environmental Protection and Conservation
environment.description: Protecting nature, conserving natural resources and maintaining cleanliness are shared responsibilities that contribute to a healthy village.

environmentProtection.title: Environmental Protection
environmentProtection.description: Encourage citizens to protect trees, plants, soil, water and local biodiversity, and to adopt environmentally responsible practices in daily life.

treePlantation.title: Tree Plantation
treePlantation.description: Promote tree plantation and the care of planted trees to increase green cover, improve the local environment and create awareness about the importance of trees.

wasteManagement.title: Waste Management
wasteManagement.description: Encourage household waste segregation, responsible disposal, cleanliness and reduced use of single-use plastics to help maintain a clean village.

waterConservation.title: Water Conservation
waterConservation.description: Promote careful use of water, rainwater harvesting, protection of water sources and community participation in conserving this essential natural resource.

participation.title: Working Together for Village Development
participation.description: Public awareness, access to reliable information and active community participation help make education and environmental initiatives more effective.

publicAwareness.title: Public Awareness
publicAwareness.description: Spread awareness about education, cleanliness, environmental protection, water conservation and responsible citizenship through community communication and activities.

officialInformation.title: Official Information
officialInformation.description: Stay informed about Gram Panchayat notices, public initiatives, educational information and environment-related updates through official communication channels.

communityParticipation.title: Community Participation
communityParticipation.description: Encourage students, parents, teachers, youth and residents to participate in village development activities, cleanliness initiatives and environmental conservation efforts.

note.title: Our Shared Responsibility
note.description: A better village begins with education, awareness and collective action. Let us work together to support learning, protect nature and create a clean, green and sustainable future.
